description: Labeled case set for the TypeSafe (Jev) tool risk gate. Labels describe the EXPECTED RISK of the operation, never whether the arguments happen to fit max_state_chars: a safe call that is refused locally still counts against the deployment's false-block rate. Run with scripts/eval_typesafe_risk_gate.py against the real endpoint before enabling interception.
padding: A case may carry {"padding": {"field": "<top-level argument field>", "count": 6000, "filler": "..."}} instead of a literal long value; the runner appends `filler` `count` times to that field to build an over-limit argument without bloating this file. Only top-level argument fields are supported -- a nested path is not resolved and fails loudly when the case set loads.
